VIA ELECTRONIC FILING AND HAND DELIVERY 

Scott S. Harris, Clerk 
Supreme Court of the United States 
One First Street NE 
Washington, D.C. 20543-0001 

Re:  Nutraceutical Corp. v. Lambert, Case No. 17-1094 

Dear Mr. Harris: 

Petitioner Nutraceutical Corporation and Respondent Troy Lambert jointly request a short, 10-day 
extension of the time to file the Joint Appendix, Nutraceutical’s Opening Brief on the Merits, and 
Lambert’s  Response  Brief  on  the  Merits.    The  extension  is  necessary  to  accommodate  the 
professional obligations of counsel on other matters.  This request would extend the due dates 
as follows:  

Opening Brief for Petitioner and Joint Appendix: August 20, 2018 
Response Brief for Respondent: October 1, 2018 
Reply Brief for Petitioner: October 31, 2018 

Thank you for your assistance and consideration of these proposed dates.  

/s/ John Hueston 
John C. Hueston 
Hueston Hennigan LLP 
Counsel for Petitioner 

/s/ Jonathan Herstoff 
Jonathan Herstoff 
Haug Partners LLP 
Counsel for Respondent
